context.validated_for: uncached long-context retrieval and sustained visible generation

caveats: Validated on two RTX 5060 Ti 16GB cards with Q6_K, f16 KV, tensor split 50,50, and one request slot.
Retrieval passed twice at ~115.4K prompt tokens; sustained generation passed twice at ~91.8K prompt tokens with 3,072 generated tokens and client-visible output required.

Qwen3.8 emits substantial hidden reasoning. The sustained allowance is 3,072 tokens while the minimum generated-work threshold remains 1,076 tokens, so thinking-heavy output can reach a visible answer without weakening the work requirement.
Measured with the seed cards' core/SM clock locked at 2300 MHz; throughput is specific to that operating point.
131K is the highest tier tested here, not a maximum-context claim.
The single-card IQ3_XXS 64K q8 route remains the recommended one-card Qwen3.8 preset; this is the higher-quality dual-card alternative.
